data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific-educational journal figure at 1536x512 while preserving the current v7 layout, style, repeated panels, depth thumbnails, state circles, policy blocks, dynamics blocks, EMA blocks, losses, and legend. Keep the clear next-state merge circles and all existing labels unless explicitly corrected. Do NOT add Q_t, M_t, or a separate R renderer.

Critical correction: remove every solid red arrow from L_flight to the orange EMA block. L_flight must NOT directly update EMA or the camera branch. Keep red gradient/backprop arrows from L_flight only toward f_dyn, u_k, Pi_f / Pi_theta, D_obs,k, and S_phi. If there is a dashed red availability/frozen indication near the Pi_c camera head, keep it dashed only so it does not look like a solid update.

Camera update clarity: keep the black forward arrow from Pi_c -> c*_{k+1} into EMA, and add/strengthen a black forward arrow from the current state circle's camera component c_k into EMA. EMA output remains c_{k+1}, then merges with x_{k+1} from f_dyn at the next-state merge. Ensure no red arrow points into EMA.

Dynamics update clarity: f_dyn receives x_k and u_k, and outputs x_{k+1}. Do not make EMA feed f_dyn, and do not make f_dyn feed EMA. Keep the black forward path from f_dyn to the merge and onward to x_{k+1}.

Perception-to-policy path: keep S_phi -> D_obs,k -> Pi_theta as a clear black forward path. D_obs,k remains the grayscale depth thumbnail.

Backward gradient semantics: L_sens / L_teach has red gradients to S_phi and c_k, with label dL/dc_k. L_flight has red gradients to f_dyn and Pi_f path only.

Avoid: solid red arrows into EMA, solid red arrows into Pi_c, missing c_k -> EMA, missing f_dyn output x_{k+1}, changed labels, tiny text, clutter, watermark, logo. Preserve all other visual details and ensure a clean journal-quality final figure.
